rca of the issue: Dashboard mockup KPI overlap: The container div in /app/frontend/src/components/Animated.jsx line ~544 uses `grid grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-3` inside a fixed-width mockup panel (~340px wide scaled). At xl (≥1280) the 4-column split gives each card only ~66px clientWidth. Values `₹84,200` (needs ~90px at 20px font) and `16.8%` (needs ~75px) with `whitespace-nowrap` don't wrap — and because the card divs default to `overflow: visible`, the text bleeds rightward into the next card's space. Fix options: (1) format value as `₹84.2K` (shortest); (2) use `overflow-hidden` + `truncate` to at least clip; (3) drop xl:grid-cols-4 back to grid-cols-2 permanently; (4) reduce font on values to text-sm sm:text-base xl:text-lg.
